baseball: a satellite image of a baseball field with a clear diamond-shaped sports layout and compact infield structure, different from stadium by lacking a large enclosing venue.
beach: a satellite image of beach with bright coastal sand and a distinct land-water boundary, different from desert by direct shoreline contact with water.
bridge: a satellite image of bridge with a narrow man-made crossing over water or land, different from overpass by weaker elevated road-junction pattern.
dense_residential: a satellite image of dense residential area with tightly clustered houses and highly compact roof distribution, different from sparse residential area by much smaller building spacing.
desert: a satellite image of desert with broad barren terrain and weak vegetation presence, different from field by lacking organized open-land structure.
field: a satellite image of field with open land and relatively regular surface texture, different from meadow by slightly stronger organized appearance.
forest: a satellite image of forest with dense tree canopy and continuous dark green vegetation texture, different from field by lacking open-land structure.
harbor: a satellite image of harbor with shore-side docks, port structures, and maritime organization, different from bridge by lacking a simple narrow crossing form.
intersection: a satellite image of intersection with several roads meeting in a compact node, different from parking by lacking organized parked-vehicle rows.
meadow: a satellite image of meadow with broad natural grassland and weak structural boundaries, different from field by weaker man-made organization.
overpass: a satellite image of overpass with visible elevated crossing and grade separation, different from intersection by stronger layered crossing structure.
parking: a satellite image of parking area with paved ground and regular parking-row layout, different from stadium by lacking a central sports-field structure.
railway: a satellite image of railway with parallel tracks and elongated linear transport pattern, different from overpass by stronger track continuity.
river: a satellite image of river with a continuous elongated water channel and natural banks, different from harbor by weaker dock-side infrastructure.
sparse_residential: a satellite image of sparse residential area with separated houses and large empty gaps, different from dense residential area by more scattered building distribution.
stadium: a satellite image of stadium with a large sports complex and strong enclosing venue structure, different from storage tank by lacking compact circular industrial containers.
storage_tank: a satellite image of storage tank area with clustered circular tanks and strong industrial round geometry, different from harbor by weaker shoreline maritime context.
